name: Account receiving funds from multiple apparent fraud victims
description: A new or low-activity account receives payments from several unrelated individuals who appear to be victims of fraud or phishing, followed by onward movement or cash-out.
fp: Legitimate sales, crowdfunding or refunds can look similar; check payment references and account history.
